gui.mysticaloaktree.llm_welcome.title: A Wise Oak Awakens
gui.mysticaloaktree.llm_welcome.message: The %s can speak using a local AI model that runs on your own machine. To enable this, an LLM runner executable must be downloaded from the internet. Nothing is sent to any server you don't control. What would you like to do?
gui.mysticaloaktree.llm_welcome.custom_h: Paste a direct download link to an LLM runner executable. It will be saved and run as-is, so only use sources you trust.
